expectation_note: Each 'invalid' entry carries expected_json_path and expected_validator, measured by qa-engineer against jsonschema Draft 2020-12 (code-reviewer Medium 2, Phase 0 gate). For topic names all twelve pin 'anyOf' at '$', which is DELIBERATELY WEAK EVIDENCE and is accepted as such: a topic name is one string checked against one grammar, so every rejection is 'matched no branch'. Splitting the schema into named branches would not improve it - a bad env charset and an unknown kind would still fail the same anyOf - so the schema is not being restructured for this. The 'reason' text is what records WHY; the assertion records THAT. Architect decision at the Phase 0 gate; do not relitigate without a concrete better mechanism.
